title: Test sets
description: The test sets of a repository, in qa.yaml at its root: which runner runs which tests, at which level, in which folders, and with which command.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

name.description: Unique in the file. The CLI and the editor select a set by it.

level.description: unit, story or integration for ordinary tests; IQ, OQ, PQ or IU for qualification tests, whose results come from qualify evidence.

runner.description: The ID of a runner definition, such as vitest or cucumber-js.

paths.description: The package folders the set covers, relative to the repository root. A glob such as packages/* covers every folder it matches.

files.description: Globs of the test files inside each package folder. The runner definition's globs when left out.

command.description: The command that runs the set in a package folder, such as `task test:intended-use -- ${ids}`. The runner definition's command when left out. Placeholders: ${filter}, ${id}, ${ids}, ${package}, ${results}.

results.description: Where the set's results land, relative to the package folder. Qualify evidence for a qualification level, JUnit XML otherwise.
